title: Add compact RAG contracts playground and UX guides
author: Priya Kulkarni
release_notes: Adds a compact RAG contracts playground and step-by-step UX guides for authoring, validating, and evolving tool contracts. Includes interactive examples (Node + Go), failure-injection simulator, and telemetry probes for contract regression detection.
description:
Summary: This PR introduces a compact "Contracts Playground" for RAG-style tool-calling documentation and a set of UX-focused authoring guides. Motivation: teams frequently ask for a minimal, runnable playground embedded in the docs that teaches correct contract shaping, structured-output linting, and how to design fallbacks for flaky tool runtimes without needing a full demo app. This playground is intentionally small (static site-friendly) and focuses on the authoring surface and telemetry hooks rather than production serving.

What it adds: - docs/playgrounds/rag-contracts/index.md — overview, intent, and quickstart steps. - docs/playgrounds/rag-contracts/editor.html — lightweight in-browser editor that validates tool contracts (JSON schema) and runs a simulated tool runtime with failure-injection modes (latency, partial response, error). - docs/playgrounds/rag-contracts/examples/node-sample.md and examples/go-sample.md — minimal code snippets showing how to wire the contract to Redwood SDK calls and structured-output assertions. - docs/guides/contract-evolution.md — UX guidance for versioning contracts, authoring checklists, and rollback patterns. - docs/guides/telemetry-contracts.md — recommended telemetry probe placement and example dashboards. - static assets and a small JS validator (src/docs-assets/rag-contract-validator.js).

Checklist (what I validated before opening): - [x] Editor validates contract schema and returns clear, actionable errors. - [x] Failure-injection simulator shows fallback behavior and logs structured traces. - [x] Examples compile/format (Node/Go snippets) and are copy-paste runnable. - [x] Docs site link-checks and local preview run. - [x] Telemetry examples include sample Grafana/Prometheus query snippets.

Commits (high level): - 1f3b2c0: add docs playground scaffold + editor assets - 2a7d91e: add node/go sample snippets and quickstart steps - 4d8f3b4: add UX guides (contract evolution + telemetry) - 7b2a9c1: fix relative links, address reviewer feedback on schema names

Files changed (high level): - docs/playgrounds/rag-contracts/index.md (+120 lines) - docs/playgrounds/rag-contracts/editor.html (+210 lines, small JS validator embedded) - docs/playgrounds/rag-contracts/examples/node-sample.md (+44 lines) - docs/playgrounds/rag-contracts/examples/go-sample.md (+36 lines) - docs/guides/contract-evolution.md (+65 lines) - src/docs-assets/rag-contract-validator.js (+87 lines)

Review conversation (select highlights): - @Arjun Mehta: "Nice compact demo. Request: rename the top-level field 'toolSpec' to 'tool_contract' to align with the runtime bindings and reduce ambiguity with our older 'spec' types."  - Author (Priya): "Agreed — renamed and added a short migration note in contract-evolution.md. See commit 7b2a9c1." - @Clara Nguyen: "Can we make the failure-injection modes deterministic (seeded) for reproducible e2e screenshots used in tests? Also add a short note on SLO/latency expectations."  - Author: "Added a ?seed= param to the editor and documented the seeded mode; included recommended latency buckets and example SLO query in telemetry guide." - @Miguel Santos: "Telemetry examples look useful; consider calling out cardinality/labeling guidance for tool ids and contract versions."  - Author: "Added a small section with suggested labels (tool_id, contract_version, shard) and a sample PromQL query."

CI summary: - build: pass - lint: pass (docs lint + markdownlinkcheck) - docs-preview: initially failed due to a broken relative link in examples/go-sample.md; fixed in 7b2a9c1 and rerun - e2e-smoke: pass (local puppeteer run validating editor load and sample executions) - accessibility-check: pass (lightweight checks) Final status: all checks green after fix.

Testing steps for reviewers: 1) yarn docs:dev and open /playgrounds/rag-contracts/editor.html 2) Paste the example contract in the quickstart section and run simulations with different failure modes 3) Toggle ?seed=42 to reproduce a screenshot and confirm the same behavior across runs 4) Run markdownlinkcheck and the docs linter locally (scripts provided in README snippet)

Compatibility & caveats: - This playground is a learning and validation tool — it is not intended as a production SDK runtime. The simulator covers common failure classes (time out, partial JSON, explicit error) but not complex multi-tool orchestration. - The editor includes a lightweight validator (no heavy schema libs) to keep the bundle small; for deeper validation we link out to the repo's canonical schema validators.

Merge notes: Addressed naming and link feedback from reviewers; CI green after fix. Merged via squash on 2026-02-25.

Related: ENG-2281 tracks a larger follow-up to add a contract-first CI job and a contract-regression alert; PM-431 adds the UX copy edits backlog item.
